say:1:1421205001:1.source_cn: 太好了！斐利尔大人的笔记……

say:3:1421205003:0.text: Let's open it and take a look.

document:4:173:0.text:
I've found another journal today!
The Dark Forest of our olden days is truly a sight to behold...
The journal speaks of the everlasting flowers in the forest, and the dappled shadows on the ground as sunlight filters through the canopy.
It breaks my heart thinking about how the Hypogeans destroyed my beautiful homeland!
The Dark Forest was such a wonderful place...
So, I've come to a decision...
Since going home is no longer possible, I'll just recreate a piece of the Dark Forest here!
<align="right">By Feli</align>
document:4:173:0.source_cn:
今天又找到了一份珍贵的手札！
我们旧日生活的薄暮丛林真是太美了……
手札里记载了那里会有永不凋零的花朵，而阳光穿过树叶时会洒下斑驳的光影。
一想到这么美的故乡被恶魔毁了，我的心就好痛！
薄暮丛林明明是那么美好的地方……
所以，我决定了——
既然不能重返故乡，我就试试在这里复现一小片薄暮丛林的景象吧！
<align="right">——斐利尔</align>

say:5:1421205004:0.text: It seems that Master Feli was studying old manuscripts.
say:5:1421205004:0.source_cn: 这是……斐利尔大人在研究旧手札。

say:6:1421205005:1.text: Yes, it appears he found information about the Dark Forest and wanted to see it.
say:6:1421205005:1.source_cn: 看样子他找到了薄暮丛林的相关资料，并且心怀向往。

choice_prompt:7:1421205005.text: Yes, it appears he found information about the Dark Forest and wanted to see it.
choice_prompt:7:1421205005.source_cn: 看样子他找到了薄暮丛林的相关资料，并且心怀向往。

say:8:1421205006:1.text: I'm not sure. Let's continue reading.
say:8:1421205006:1.source_cn: 我不确定，后面好像还有内容，我们接着看吧。

document:9:174:0.text:
I've completed the sketch for my experimental forest today.
Reminders to myself: Use magic to maintain the optimal humidity and temperature.
And prepare a special nutrient solution...
After that, I'll conduct a site inspection!
A secluded spot off the beaten path would be perfect!
Ah! I've spent too much time on this! I almost forgot about tomorrow's ceremony!
I've got to hurry and prepare the items needed.
Hopefully, I can finish this little experiment soon...
By then, everyone will get to experience the joy of living above ground once more!
<align="right">By Feli</align>
document:9:174:0.source_cn:
今天设计好了实验林地的草图。
注意事项是得用魔法控制好湿度和温度，
还要调配特殊的营养液……
之后再实际考察一下具体的位置吧！
希望找个暂时不被大家发现的地方！
啊！搞这个的时间太久了，差点耽误了明天的仪式！
得赶紧去准备仪式用品了。
但愿能早日完成这个小实验……
让大家一起重新体味地表的美好！
<align="right">——斐利尔</align>

say:10:1421205007:1.text: No wonder Master Feli was hard to find sometimes. He went into the forest to do experiments.
say:10:1421205007:1.source_cn: 怪不得……斐利尔大人经常不见人影。原来，他是去林地做实验了。

say:11:1421205008:1.text: ... Now I finally understand why he followed you to the surface.
say:11:1421205008:1.source_cn: ……我总算明白当时斐利尔为什么跟着你们去地表了。

say:12:1421205009:1.text: He must've always longed for the world above. That's why he designed the experimental forest to replicate the beauty he imagined.
say:12:1421205009:1.source_cn: 他应该一直都很向往地表，所以才会设计实验林地，为了复刻...

choice_prompt:13:1421205009.text: He must've always longed for the world above. That's why he designed the experimental forest to replicate the beauty he imagined.
choice_prompt:13:1421205009.source_cn: 他应该一直都很向往地表，所以才会设计实验林地，为了复刻想象中的美好。

say:14:1421205010:1.text: I don't know. He never told me. Let's keep reading.
say:14:1421205010:1.source_cn: 我不知道，他也没有跟我提过。我们接着看下去吧。

document:15:175:0.text:
I've found the perfect spot!
It's located to the <style="highlight">northwest of the Lunaris Altar</style>. Hardly anyone ever goes there...
Commoners have no access to the altar, and the priests have no business in that far-flung corner.
After a careful check, I've confirmed that the magic in that area is stable...
The soil there is ideal for growing plants, and the light there resembles the moonlight described in the journal!
I took some planting tools over there earlier today. Hopefully, the patrolling guards didn't notice me.
<align="right">By Feli</align>
document:15:175:0.source_cn:
找到合适的地方了！
就在<style="highlight">银月祭庭的西北角</style>，那里几乎没有人去……
平民们进不了祭庭，祭司们也不会去偏僻的那里。
我仔细观察过了，周围的魔法能量很稳定……
地面的土壤也很适合培育植物，那里的光线和手札中描述的月色很像！
今天偷偷搬了一些培育工具过去，希望不会被巡逻的卫兵发现。
<align="right">——斐利尔</align>

say:16:1421205011:1.text: Master Feli was remarkable. As far as I can remember, priests rarely went there.
say:16:1421205011:1.source_cn: 斐利尔大人，好、好厉害！我印象中，祭司大人们基本不会去那里。

say:17:1421205012:1.text: Yes, that place is quite hidden.
say:17:1421205012:1.source_cn: 嗯，确实是个隐蔽的地方。

say:18:1421205013:1.text: Generally speaking, the guards would never patrol northwest of Lunaris Altar.
say:18:1421205013:1.source_cn: 一般而言，卫兵们也不会去银月祭庭的西北角巡逻。

say:19:1421205014:1.text: I've seen Master Feli go there alone a few times. I thought he was there to perform a ceremony or ritual.
say:19:1421205014:1.source_cn: 我撞见过几次斐利尔大人独自前往，我还以为他……是去进行仪式。

say:20:1421205015:1.text: Let's go now. Perhaps some of his experiments are still there.
say:20:1421205015:1.source_cn: 我们去看看吧，也许……他的实验还留在那里。
